name: mount-options
description: nodev/nosuid/noexec on sensitive mountpoints (CIS 1.1).  Absent keys/paths SKIP, never false-fail.

rules.title: /tmp mounted with nodev
rules.rationale: Mounting /tmp with nodev shrinks what an attacker who can write there can do (run code / device nodes / setuid).
rules.fix: Add nodev to the /tmp mount options in /etc/fstab and remount.

rules.title: /tmp mounted with nosuid
rules.rationale: Mounting /tmp with nosuid shrinks what an attacker who can write there can do (run code / device nodes / setuid).
rules.fix: Add nosuid to the /tmp mount options in /etc/fstab and remount.

rules.title: /tmp mounted with noexec
rules.rationale: Mounting /tmp with noexec shrinks what an attacker who can write there can do (run code / device nodes / setuid).
rules.fix: Add noexec to the /tmp mount options in /etc/fstab and remount.
